name: Inoue Sanae
source:
A seriously clumsy nurture-type VTuber who earnestly replies to every viewer's comments and opinions. Her unique personality charm has attracted many caring, directive-type fans, and her dedication to improving in areas where she is not proficient is moving. Despite not being so young, she chooses to become a VTuber to fulfill her dreams.

She appears to be a mature married woman living a stable and smooth life, but inside, she seems to be suffering due to certain reasons.
